nodes.name: When Chat Message Received
nodes.notes:
Chat Trigger webhook that opens the n8n built-in chat UI when this workflow is active.

Input: user's message, passed as chatInput to the AI RAG Agent.

To test:
  1. Activate the workflow
  2. Click this node
  3. Click "Open Chat" at the bottom of the panel

The chat UI runs in the browser — no external frontend needed.
For production, embed the chat widget URL in your own web application.

nodes.name: AI RAG Agent

options.systemMessage:
You are a helpful, accurate knowledge base assistant.

RULES:
1. ALWAYS use the "Search Knowledge Base" tool to find relevant information before answering any question.
2. Base your answer strictly on the retrieved context. Do not add information that is not present in the results.
3. If the retrieved context does not contain enough information to answer confidently, respond:
   "I don't have enough information in my knowledge base to answer that accurately. Could you rephrase or ask something related?"
4. Be concise and direct. When multiple sources are retrieved, synthesise them into a single coherent answer.
5. Use the conversation history to correctly handle follow-up questions and pronouns.
6. Never fabricate sources, citations, or document names.

nodes.notes:
LangChain AI Agent — orchestrates the full RAG pipeline.

System prompt enforces:
  Rule 1: Always call Search Knowledge Base before answering
  Rule 2: Answer only from retrieved context (no hallucination)
  Rule 3: Graceful fallback when context is insufficient
  Rule 4: Synthesise multiple sources into one coherent answer
  Rule 5: Use conversation history for follow-ups and pronouns
  Rule 6: Never fabricate sources, document names, or citations

Sub-nodes:
  - OpenAI Chat Model    (ai_languageModel) — the LLM used for generation
  - Simple Memory        (ai_memory)        — conversation history window
  - Search Knowledge Base (ai_tool)         — vector search over document_chunks

nodes.name: OpenAI Chat Model
nodes.notes:
GPT-4o at temperature 0.2.
Connected as ai_languageModel sub-node to the AI RAG Agent.

Temperature 0.2: low variance — reduces hallucination risk and keeps
answers grounded in the retrieved context. Ideal for factual RAG use.

Tuning options:
  - Raise to 0.5-0.7 for a more conversational / creative tone
  - Switch to gpt-4o-mini to reduce cost (lower quality, faster)
  - Use temperature 0 for fully deterministic classification tasks

Credential: OpenAI account (openAiApi)

nodes.name: Simple Memory
nodes.notes:
In-memory sliding window retaining the last 10 messages
(5 user turns + 5 assistant turns).
Connected as ai_memory sub-node to the AI RAG Agent.

Enables the agent to handle follow-up questions and pronoun references
(e.g. "What else does it say about that?") correctly.

Limitation: resets when the n8n server restarts.
Not suitable for chat history that must persist across sessions.

To add persistent memory across sessions:
  Replace with Supabase Chat History (memorySupabaseChatMessageHistory)
  and add the n8n_chat_histories table to supabase-setup.sql.
  See Claude.md → AI Node Configuration → Memory → Option B.

nodes.name: Search Knowledge Base

parameters.toolDescription: Search the knowledge base for information relevant to the user question. Always call this tool before formulating an answer.

nodes.notes:
Supabase vector store in retrieve-as-tool mode.
Connected as ai_tool sub-node to the AI RAG Agent.

The AI Agent calls this tool automatically before every answer
(enforced by Rule 1 in the system prompt).

How it works:
  1. Embeds the user question using OpenAI Embeddings (ai_embedding sub-node)
  2. Runs cosine similarity search via the match_documents RPC in Supabase
  3. Returns the top 5 most similar document chunks to the agent

Settings:
  - Table: document_chunks
  - RPC: match_documents
  - topK: 5 (increase to 10 for broad topics; decrease to 3 for precise retrieval)

Credential: Supabase account (supabaseApi)

nodes.name: OpenAI Embeddings
nodes.notes:
text-embedding-3-small model (1536 dimensions).
Connected as ai_embedding sub-node to Search Knowledge Base.

Embeds the user's question into a vector so it can be compared
against stored document chunk embeddings using cosine similarity.

CRITICAL: must use the SAME model as the Sub-workflow's
"Embed Documents to Supabase" node.

If this model is changed, all existing embeddings are invalidated.
Every document must be re-ingested to regenerate compatible vectors,
otherwise the vector space is incompatible and retrieval will fail.

Credential: OpenAI account (openAiApi)

parameters.content:
## Chat RAG — Chat Interface

**PURPOSE:**
Provides a conversational AI chat interface grounded in the knowledge base.
Uses a LangChain AI Agent with a RAG-enforcing system prompt to retrieve
relevant document chunks from Supabase before every response.
Prevents hallucination by requiring search before every answer.

**TRIGGER:**
Chat Trigger webhook — opens an interactive chat UI when the workflow is active.
Activate workflow → click "When Chat Message Received" → click "Open Chat".

**INPUT:**
  chatInput (string) — the user's message from the chat widget

**OUTPUT / RESULT:**
AI-generated response displayed in the chat UI.
Grounded in document chunks retrieved from document_chunks.
Graceful fallback message when no relevant context is found.

**CREDENTIALS REQUIRED:**
  - OpenAI Chat Model      → OpenAI account (openAiApi)
  - Search Knowledge Base  → Supabase account (supabaseApi)
  - OpenAI Embeddings      → OpenAI account (openAiApi)

**CONNECTED WORKFLOWS:**
  - Knowledge base populated by: Chat RAG - Ingest Google Drive - v1 (dzxVlm0ygn25EVFz)

**SETTINGS:**
  - Model: gpt-4o @ temperature 0.2 (low = grounded, factual)
  - Memory: 10-message sliding window (in-memory, resets on restart)
  - Embeddings: text-embedding-3-small (1536-dim — must match ingest)
  - Retrieval: top 5 chunks via cosine similarity (match_documents RPC)
